camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnRefreshTasks --region cn-hangzhou --Status Complete --ObjectType file --ObjectPath 'http://example.com/examplefile.txt' --TaskId 704225667 --PageSize 20 --EndTime '2017-01-01T12:13:20Z' --PageNumber 2 --DomainName 'example.com' --StartTime '2017-01-01T12:12:20Z'
description_en: Call DescribeDcdnRefreshTasks to query the completion status of refresh and preload tasks submitted within the last 3 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnRefreshTasks查询刷新、预热状态是否在全网生效，支持查询3天内的数据
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-refresh-tasks --task-id 704225667 --object-path http://example.com/examplefile.txt --page-number 2 --object-type file --domain-name example.com --status Complete --page-size 20 --start-time 2017-01-01T12:12:20Z --end-time 2017-01-01T12:13:20Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnRefreshTasks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task. A task ID is returned after you create a refresh or preload task
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，当您创建刷新或预热任务，会返回任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The path of the object to query. The path must be a full path
parameters.name: object_path

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:

file: refreshes URLs.

directory: refreshes directories.

regex: refreshes content based on a regular expression.

preload: preloads URLs.

This parameter is required if you specify DomainName or Status
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。

file：刷新URL。
directory：刷新目录。
regex：正则刷新。
preload：预热URL。

当指定DomainName或Status时，该参数必填
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one accelerated domain name. By default, this operation queries tasks for all accelerated domain names
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，仅支持单个查询，默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

Complete: The task is complete.

Refreshing: The task is in progress.

Timeout: The task timed out.

Canceled: The task is canceled.

Failed: The task failed
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。

Complete：完成。
Refreshing：处理中。
Timeout：超时未执行。
Canceled：取消。
Failed：失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 50. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。默认值：20，最大值：50，取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time
